text: When a review requires manual browser/device testing the agent cannot do, fix the code issues, post a blocking PR comment, apply `human-decision-required` (not `ready-for-review`) and ask a human to record the results.

Reworker: after adding `ready-for-review`, also remove leftover platform tracking labels (`ready-for-review:completed`, stale `revisions-required:completed`/`:wip`) via `gh pr edit <N> --remove-label`, then verify with `gh pr view --json labels`; this supersedes the earlier note that agents leave them alone.

child-page: an activity can ship disabled in the menu via `defaultOff: true` on its js/activities.js entry; js/menu-config.js uses it for defaults(), reset and newly appended activities (existing saved configs unchanged).
